evidence.value: Face-on molecular material behind Her36/9Sgr; distinct foreground veil advances toward Earth and west.
evidence.scope: Approximately 1.3 by 1.3 pc around Her36, at the paper distance 1250 pc

evidence.scope: Local [CII]/CO channel maps around Her36, Sections3.2 and5.1
evidence.limitations: Ranges summarize different tracers/components, not per-pixel velocities with errors. No velocity-to-depth conversion or inferred expansion age is used.

evidence.value: Patchy obscuring screen; optically dark regions can have weak Balmer ratios because deeper emission is hidden.
evidence.limitations: Positive emission cannot model absorption, hidden luminosity or dust density. Local optical diagnostics probe only the visible skin.

evidence.value: Five additional HH candidates from continuum-subtracted Halpha/[SII] morphology.
evidence.scope: WFI field and local Table1 positions
evidence.limitations: Authors defer spectroscopic confirmation for some features; unmeasured inclinations and material speeds remain unknown. Their knots are smaller than this wide-field bake.

evidence.value: Expansion preferentially in declination; no matching global RA expansion pattern.
evidence.scope: GES/Gaia DR2 selected young stellar members

evidence.value: WC, EC, SE and SC clump groups have distinct velocity patterns; EC double components may be separate dense layers.
evidence.limitations: Interaction between overlapping EC components is unresolved without mapping. Connectivity in projection cannot decide their depth order.

evidence.scope: Pointings and survey photometry in Sections2.1–2.4
evidence.limitations: Hi-GAL incomplete; AKARI cannot resolve smaller clumps; Spitzer 24micron can contain unrelated foreground emission and saturation. Native spectral arrays are not imported.
The speed derives from assumed constant propagation and YSO age separation, not direct motion. Foreground/back ordering and inclination remain unknown; no speed sets model depth.

evidence.scope: LVM 10-tile survey; 2023-08-22 to2023-10-19 plus2024-07-02; paper SectionsIII andVI.1
evidence.limitations: Balmer extinction depends on adopted law; physical line maps need IVAR, MASK, fibre positions and line-specific S/N. Figure set is plotted evidence, not numerical FITS or depth; spatial scatter is not error on mean.

evidence.value: One coherent irregular finite emitting layer; local Her36 orientation guided by PDR interpretation; M8E gets a bounded local deformation.
evidence.scope: Full covered image field; literature guidance remains local
evidence.limitations: One surface cannot implement the separate veil, overlapping molecular layers, true cavities, scattering or general swept filaments. Emission follows registered projected evidence; depth never follows RGB brightness.

evidence.scope: Full model and both local windows
evidence.limitations: No measured physical size or uncertainty is invented; windows bound literature-guided topology, not measured cloud edges. 1250pc is retained only for converting the local paper footprint; no global distance scale is fit.
